DesignSignalPacket.scope: Final bounded composition review; preserve Voltron geometry, materials, routing and typography

composition_state.grid: Existing responsive page containers and alternating two-column hero/one-column phone composition
composition_state.primary_anchor_rule: One primary subject per section: identity cube, physical operation, portrait, factory network, capability head, tree or shared brief
composition_state.supporting_anchor_rule: Projector/globe/frames support the focal object; labels stay outside its silhouette
composition_state.negative_space_policy: Reserve text/artwork separation and port/label space; do not add background particles to fill useful whitespace
composition_state.negative_space_ratio: Not measured globally; responsive text/artwork geometry varies by section
composition_state.safety_margin: Use existing responsive gutters, plus measured label bounds; skill's general 6–8% rule is guidance rather than a replacement for established page spacing
composition_state.evidence: Current 96-case responsive matrix, 20 accessibility/text-stress cases, 14 interaction evidence rows and retained scene contact/pose reviews; see final-local-acceptance-2026-11-05.md
composition_state.signoff: Local implementation accepted; physical-device performance remains unverified and no deployment is authorized
